en: Crossing land after land,
Fording the waters of flowing rivers,
Crossing lofty, forbidding mountains,
Pressing onward without sparing themselves,
When they came out upon the ridge,
At the center of the land was Bozdöngül,
Drawing up beside Bozdöngül,
They arrived and now made camp.
The camp was pitched and the host spread glittering,
One cauldron for every ten men,
They carefully laid out their food,
The captains of hundreds gathered,
The captains of thousands made ready,
They raised blue-mottled tents,
They shot maral deer from the cliffs,
They gave themselves to many amusements,
The whole army took its rest,
Propped on their elbows, they slept,
Dozing awhile, they rested,
Lying down until their hips grew weary,
Reclining, they slept their fill,
The stars separated across the sky,
Light poured upon the earth,
Stars sparkled overhead,
The constellation Taraza, sign of dawn,
Hurried toward the qibla,
All the seams of dawn opened,
Light poured upon the earth,
The cold wind before daybreak
Whistled down the valley,
Every living creature
Stirred and scurried over the ground,
The people awoke and the camp bustled,
Expecting an order from their commander,
All the people stood waiting.
